name: Lychee Sorbet
desc: A light and refreshing sorbet that captures the delicate floral sweetness of lychee.
note: It was a bit too sweet, so I would reduce the sugar to 1 cup next time.

sections.title: Lychee Sorbet Base
steps: In a saucepan, combine all the ingredients and heat over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved.
Remove from heat and chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour.

sections.title: Assembly
steps: Churn the lychee sorbet base in an ice cream maker until it reaches slushy consistency.
